unverified.bore_in: 3.80 in: Oldsmobile 1988 Mid-Size catalog p.18 (Calais spec table 'Bore/Stroke (in.) 3.800/2.660') and Wikipedia ('same bore size as its larger sibling' = 3.8 in). Only 2 independent. Over-Drive's Buick V6 article copies Wikipedia word for word; spec sites (automobile-catalog, ultimatespecs) are excluded and some wrongly give 3.96. NHRA 181 rows have no bore.
unverified.stroke_in: 2.66 in: same two sources (Olds 1988 catalog '3.800/2.660'; Wikipedia 'smaller stroke of 2.66 in'). AUWM says only 'short-stroke'. Only 2.
unverified.compression_ratio: DISPUTED. LK9: Wikipedia 8.45:1 (1982-83) / 8.4:1 (1984-85); NHRA blueprint figures 9.67 (1983) and 8.99 (1984-85) are not advertised ratings. LN7: Wikipedia 9.0:1; Olds 1988 catalog prints 8.5 to 1 (the same figure in every column of that table, so possibly a template error); NHRA lists 9.54-9.58. No three sources agree.
